dataset_title: Vocational Courses, Online Skilling & College Scholarships - Expanded Program Data
purpose: Populate a village profile's 'vocational training & scholarship access' section, mapped to SDG 4 (Quality Education), SDG 8 (Decent Work & Economic Growth), and related Sustainable Development Goals.

vocational_courses.name: ITI (Industrial Training Institute) Trades
vocational_courses.run_by: State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT) / National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT), under state Labour/Skill Development Departments
vocational_courses.eligibility: 8th, 10th, or 12th pass (varies by trade); minimum age typically 14, some states allow up to 40
vocational_courses.duration: 6 months to 2 years depending on trade
vocational_courses.entry_route: State-level admission process via SCVT/Labour Department each year
progression_pathways: Lateral entry into 2nd year of Polytechnic Diploma
CITS (Craft Instructor Training Scheme) to become an ITI instructor
B.Voc / BBA / BCA / B.Tech via LEET
vocational_courses.cost: Government ITIs: low/subsidized fees; private ITIs vary
vocational_courses.notes: Fastest route to employment among vocational options - often job-ready in 6 months to 2 years.

vocational_courses.name: Polytechnic Diploma (Engineering & allied trades)
vocational_courses.run_by: State Directorate of Technical Education, AICTE-approved polytechnic colleges
vocational_courses.duration: 3 years (typically), 2 years via lateral entry after ITI
vocational_courses.entry_route: State polytechnic common entrance test (varies by state) or direct admission
vocational_courses.cost: Government polytechnics: low fees (~few thousand INR/year); private polytechnics higher
vocational_courses.notes: Eligible for AICTE Pragati/Saksham scholarships if AICTE-approved institution.

vocational_courses.name: PMKVY (Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana) Short-Term Training
vocational_courses.run_by: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)
vocational_courses.eligibility: Varies by job role; generally open to school dropouts and unemployed youth, no strict minimum qualification for many trades
vocational_courses.duration: Typically 2-3 months per short-term course (job-role dependent)
vocational_courses.entry_route: Enroll through authorized PMKVY training centers (list on official PMKVY portal)
vocational_courses.courses_available_count: 1200+ job roles across verticals (list amended periodically by Ministry)
vocational_courses.stipend_note: Apprenticeship stipends up to approx. ₹8,000/month for select courses, per aggregator reporting - verify current rate on official PMKVY/NSDC portal before quoting.
vocational_courses.official_url_note: Search 'PMKVY' on the Skill India portal (www.skillindia.gov.in) for the current official course list, since job roles and fee-free status are updated periodically by the Ministry.
vocational_courses.notes: Best fit for rural/village-level short-term skilling in a hackathon village profile - free, short-duration, employment-oriented.

vocational_courses.name: B.Voc (Bachelor of Vocation) Degree Programs
vocational_courses.run_by: UGC-approved universities/colleges under the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF)
vocational_courses.eligibility: 12th pass (any stream, subject to institution's criteria)
vocational_courses.duration: 3 years (with exit options: Diploma after 1 year, Advanced Diploma after 2 years)
vocational_courses.cost: Varies by institution; generally lower than equivalent professional degree programs
vocational_courses.notes: Combines vocational skill training with a formal UGC-recognized degree, useful bridge between ITI-level skilling and full university education.

vocational_courses.name: DDU-GKY (Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana)
vocational_courses.run_by: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India
vocational_courses.eligibility: Rural youth aged 15-35 years from poor families (up to 45 years for SC/ST/Women/PWD)
vocational_courses.entry_route: Enrollment through District Rural Development Agencies (DRDA) or authorized PIAs (Project Implementation Agencies)
vocational_courses.cost: Free of cost (fully funded by Government, includes free boarding & lodging)
vocational_courses.notes: Specifically targeted at rural youth with guaranteed post-training placement assistance.

vocational_courses.name: RSETI (Rural Self Employment Training Institutes)
vocational_courses.run_by: Lead Banks in partnership with Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) and State Governments
vocational_courses.eligibility: Rural youth aged 18-45 years with an inclination toward self-employment
vocational_courses.entry_route: Direct application at district RSETI centers
vocational_courses.cost: Free training with free food and accommodation provided
vocational_courses.notes: Focuses on entrepreneurship development and linking trainees to bank credit for setting up micro-enterprises.

vocational_courses.name: SWAYAM Free Online Certification Courses
vocational_courses.run_by: Ministry of Education, NPTEL, IGNOU, CEC, NCERT, IIM-B, NITTTR
vocational_courses.eligibility: Open to all (Students, School Dropouts, Professionals, Village Youth)
vocational_courses.duration: 4 to 12 weeks per course (self-paced/guided online modules)
vocational_courses.cost: Free to learn; nominal exam fee (~₹1,000) only if requesting a proctored certificate
vocational_courses.notes: Ideal for rural youth with internet access seeking high-quality self-paced learning from top educators.

vocational_courses.name: PM Vishwakarma Skill Enhancement Scheme
vocational_courses.run_by: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) & MSDE
vocational_courses.eligibility: Artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in 18 traditional trades (age 18+)
vocational_courses.duration: Basic training: 5-7 days; Advanced training: 15 days or more
vocational_courses.entry_route: CSC (Common Service Centre) registration with Gram Panchayat verification
vocational_courses.cost: Free training + ₹500/day stipend during training + ₹15,000 toolkit incentive
vocational_courses.notes: Provides credit support up to ₹3 Lakh at concessional interest rate (5%) along with skill upgrading and market linkage.

college_scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
college_scholarships.run_by: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
college_scholarships.eligibility: Girl students admitted to 1st year (or 2nd year via lateral entry) of a technical degree/diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution; max 2 girls per family; family income up to ₹8,00,000/year
college_scholarships.coverage: 5,000 scholarships/year for degree courses + 5,000/year for diploma courses
college_scholarships.disbursement: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank account
college_scholarships.application_deadline_note: For 2026-27 cycle: last date 31 October 2026 (dates change annually - verify current cycle on NSP)
college_scholarships.helpline: Pragati Scholarship Helpline: 011-29581118; AICTE Help Desk: 011-26131497; NSP Help Desk: 0120-6619540
college_scholarships.notes: Covers engineering, polytechnic, pharmacy, architecture, applied arts, hotel management and other AICTE-approved programs.

college_scholarships.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Differently-Abled Students
college_scholarships.run_by: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
college_scholarships.eligibility: Students with at least 40% disability (valid disability certificate required), admitted to 1st year (or 2nd year via lateral entry) of a technical degree/diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution; family income up to ₹8,00,000/year
college_scholarships.disbursement: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank account
college_scholarships.application_deadline_note: For 2026-27 cycle: last date 31 October 2026 (verify current cycle on NSP)
college_scholarships.notes: Same amount/structure as Pragati but targeted at students with disabilities rather than girl students specifically.

college_scholarships.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship
college_scholarships.run_by: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
college_scholarships.eligibility: Orphans, COVID-affected families, wards of Armed Forces/CAPF martyrs, and other notified eligible categories, pursuing AICTE-approved technical degree/diploma programs
college_scholarships.disbursement: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank account
college_scholarships.notes: Third flagship AICTE scheme alongside Pragati and Saksham; verify current eligible-category list on NSP as it can be updated.

college_scholarships.name: Post Matric Scholarship (PMS) for SC/ST/OBC/EWS students
college_scholarships.run_by: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs / State Governments (category-dependent)
college_scholarships.eligibility: Students from SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories pursuing studies after Class 10, including polytechnic/ITI/diploma students; income ceilings vary by category and state
college_scholarships.coverage: Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance; amount varies by state and category
college_scholarships.notes: One of the most widely used vocational/diploma scholarship schemes in India; a single NSP application can route to the applicable category-specific scheme.

college_scholarships.name: State Merit-cum-Means Scholarships for Diploma/ITI Students
college_scholarships.run_by: Respective State Governments (scheme name and amount vary by state)
college_scholarships.eligibility: Diploma/ITI students meeting state-specific merit and family-income criteria
college_scholarships.coverage: Varies by state - typically partial fee waiver or fixed annual stipend
college_scholarships.application_portal: State scholarship portal or National Scholarship Portal (varies by state)
college_scholarships.notes: Since these are state-specific, exact scheme name/amount should be looked up for the specific state a village profile belongs to (e.g., Maharashtra, Gujarat, Haryana each run their own variant).

data_confidence: Vocational course structures (ITI/Polytechnic/PMKVY/B.Voc/DDU-GKY/RSETI/SWAYAM/PM Vishwakarma) and scholarship details (Pragati, Saksham, Swanath, PMS) cross-verified from AICTE, MSDE, MoRD, and NSP portals as of mid-2026. Time-sensitive stipend rates and state scholarship amounts should be re-verified on official portals prior to final submission.
